sections.html:
Pleasant Grove belongs to the Provo-Orem metro area in Utah County. Its 9.18 square miles of land sit at about 4,623 feet, and the ZIP code is 84062. Battle Creek Canyon rises above town, with Battle Creek Falls, roughly 50 feet tall, tucked inside it. A big white G on the hillside plays the role the Y does in Provo.

The 2020 count was 37,721, and the July 1, 2025 estimate is 37,773, so the city has hardly grown in five years. Two thirds of homes are owner-occupied, which means most listings here are family houses on streets of other owners.

These are citywide figures. Your own house will land above or below them depending on condition, lot and street. Average commute is 21.7 minutes, so mention how close you are to the freeway or the campuses in Orem and Provo.

The settlement was called Battle Creek after an 1849 clash between Mormon settlers and a small band of Ute people, and was later renamed for a nearby cottonwood grove. Settled in 1850, it was incorporated on January 18, 1855. The city calls itself Utah's City of Trees, and Strawberry Days, first held on June 21, 1922, still fills the third week of June with a rodeo, parades and a carnival.

sections.h2: Seasons and the roof over your head
sections.html:
Expect cold winters and hot, dry summers. Precipitation averages 16.43 inches and snowfall 41.4 inches, with recorded extremes between 104 degrees and minus 19.

  • Snow load puts a patched or aging roof to the test every winter.
  • A furnace near the end of its life announces itself in a cold January.
  • After a long dry summer, buyers ask how old the air conditioner is.

None of these repairs is required for an as-is cash sale, though a conventional buyer's inspector will notice all three.

sections.h2: Which schools serve Pleasant Grove, and what changes in 2027?
sections.html: Public schools belong to Alpine School District today, and that district ends on July 1, 2027. Under a June 2026 resource agreement, Pleasant Grove moves to the new Timpanogos district alongside Orem, Lindon and Vineyard. John Hancock Charter School and Lincoln Academy are charter choices in town, and Liahona Preparatory Academy is an accredited private K-12 school. Because boundaries are in flux, check the attendance area for your address before you quote one to a buyer.

If your house has a basement apartment or another second unit, call the planning office to learn how the city treats it before you list. A buyer's lender and the title company will both ask whether the unit is allowed. The code defines a few terms that bear on the answer.

  • A family can be one person living alone, or people related by blood, marriage, adoption or guardianship plus up to two unrelated people who pay no rent.
  • A family can also be up to four related or unrelated people living as one housekeeping unit.
  • A tiny home is a subordinate dwelling in a detached accessory structure of at least 192 square feet, on a permanent foundation with all required utilities.

Permit and registration steps for an apartment are set elsewhere in the code, so ask the city how yours was approved.

Tax bills come from Utah County. Expect the valuation notice in late July. To contest the value, file with the county Board of Equalization by September 15, or later through March 31 if you meet the extra criteria for a late appeal. The actual tax notice arrives from mid to late October.

A home that someone occupies for 183 or more consecutive days a year is taxed on 55% of its market value once the 45% exemption applies. When ownership changes, the county Assessor may send the new owner a declaration form. A rental that no eligible occupant uses full-time is treated as a secondary residence. For payoff figures on delinquent tax, phone the Treasurer at 801-851-8255.

Every Pleasant Grove deed is filed with the Utah County Recorder, 100 East Center Street, Suite 1300, in Provo. Documents must meet state recording requirements. Staff will not draft or notarize paperwork, explain what a document means, give legal advice or run a title search. For a sale, your title or escrow agent normally files. Anyone can sign up for Property Watch, which emails an alert whenever something is recorded against a property you follow. Call 801-851-8179 with questions.

If the notice value strikes you as too high, file with the county Board of Equalization online, by email, by mail or in person. Build the case first with recent sales of comparable homes, photos of defects an assessor could not see and any repair quotes. A lower assessed value also shrinks the bill the next owner takes over, so a successful appeal can make the house a little easier to sell.

sections.h2: Before you list or take an offer
sections.html: Walk through the house the way an inspector would. Jot down the age of the roof, furnace and air conditioner, and note any basement work done without a permit. Then pick a path: repair, disclose or sell as-is. Only the last involves no repair spending. Set out the deed, a recent mortgage statement and any tax notice so the title company can open its file quickly.

sections.h2: Selling a Pleasant Grove house for cash
sections.html:
Calls come from heirs, from owners facing a new roof or furnace, from people with a basement apartment nobody documented and from sellers whose move date will not wait for showings. Describe the property, let us review it and expect an offer priced from condition.

Everything is bought as-is, which takes painting and scrubbing off your plate. The closing runs through a title or escrow company that files the deed at the county. Show a photo ID at signing, plus estate papers when the house is inherited. A remaining loan is paid off from the proceeds, and you can say no to any offer.

faqs.a: Counted at 37,721 in 2020, the city is estimated at 37,773 as of July 1, 2025. Its land area is 9.18 square miles.

faqs.q: Which school district will Pleasant Grove homes belong to after 2027?
faqs.a: Pleasant Grove joins the new Timpanogos district on July 1, 2027, when Alpine is dissolved. The boundary map shows your address.

faqs.q: When must a Pleasant Grove property tax appeal be filed?
faqs.a: The Utah County Board of Equalization wants appeals filed by September 15. You can send one online, by email, by mail or in person.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Pleasant Grove house with an unapproved basement apartment?
faqs.a: Yes, we buy houses as they stand, so the apartment's status does not have to be settled first. Still ask the city how it was approved, because a conventional buyer would.

faqs.q: What does the primary residence tax exemption require?
faqs.a: Someone has to live there for 183 consecutive days in a year. The 45 percent exemption then leaves tax on 55 percent of market value.
